stories.title: Raiders’ Fernando Mendoza impresses Broncos ahead of 1st road start
stories.summary: The Denver Broncos will look to make things difficult for Raiders rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza, who will make his first career road start Sunday.

stories.title: ‘Ripe for development’: Las Vegas homebuilding group gets more public land in sales pipeline
stories.summary: The Southern Nevada Home Builders Association started a new approach to get more federal land up for sale in a faster way.

stories.title: One eating habit that can help you live longer
stories.summary: When it comes to improving both longevity and healthspan, one of the simplest places to start is your diet.

stories.title: Raiders QB went from juco coach, wedding attendee to Fernando Mendoza backup
stories.summary: Journeyman Brett Rypien was signed to the practice squad after Klint Kubiak and the Raiders became the 11th NFL franchise to give him an opportunity.

stories.title: Nakobe Dean, Raiders hope focus on details leads to improvements on defense
stories.summary: Nakobe Dean is tied for the NFL lead in tackles, but the linebacker is more concerned with helping the Raiders defense find a way to win games.

stories.title: Analysis: Homestand feels hollow after Knights can’t finish again
stories.summary: The Golden Knights lost three games in extra time during this five-game homestand, leaving an empty feeling after failing to get the job done.

stories.title: AP reporter says Texas execution Thursday was like no other he’s witnessed before
stories.summary: The Thursday execution of Reinaldo Dennes in Texas was unlike anything The Associated Press reporter Michael Graczyk had witnessed before.

stories.title: With measles spreading, do you need a booster shot?
stories.summary: The U.S., Mexico and Bolivia lost their measles-free status this past week after stubborn outbreaks erased decades of progress.

stories.title: New judge brings mental health background to courtroom
stories.summary: “Helping people process what is happening to them and to heal really matters,” Family Court Judge Gwynneth Smith says.

stories.title: Golden Knights can’t close again, lose to Stars in shootout
stories.summary: The Golden Knights blew a third-period lead for the second time in three days, losing to the Dallas Stars in a shootout Thursday at T-Mobile Arena.

stories.title: Police seek help in solving fatal North Las Vegas shooting of teen
stories.summary: The North Las Vegas Police Department is asking for the public’s help in identifying people who may have information about the fatal shooting of a teenager in July.

stories.title: ‘It’s like an ice rink’: Rain slows drivers at F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix practice
stories.summary: Rain dampened the first practice session for the Formula One Las Vegas Grand Prix, but all 22 drivers hit the track for the second session later Thursday.
